companies.name: アボット・ラボラトリーズ

relations.text: フリースタイル・リブレ系のCGM製品で長年競合している
relations.text_en: Dexcom has competed with Abbott and its Libre family of CGM products for many years

source.label: デクスコム 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We have competed with Abbott and their Libre family of CGM products for many years.

relations.text: 2024年にアボットと特許訴訟を解決する和解・ライセンス契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In 2024 Dexcom entered into a settlement and license agreement with Abbott to settle all pending patent infringement proceedings

source.label: デクスコム 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We have been involved in various patent infringement actions in the past and in 2024, we entered into a settlement and license agreement with Abbott to settle all pending patent infringement legal proceedings brought by Abbott against us.

relations.text: ミニメド部門がガーディアン・コネクトなどの血糖測定製品を販売している
relations.text_en: Medtronic (MiniMed) markets and sells a standalone glucose monitoring product called Guardian Connect

source.label: デクスコム 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Medtronic (MiniMed) markets and sells a standalone glucose monitoring product called Guardian Connect, both internationally and in the United States, and a disposable CGM system called Simplera in the U.S.

source.quote: Amended and Restated Collaboration and License Agreement, dated November 20, 2018, by and between DexCom, Inc. and Verily Life Sciences LLC

relations.text: アップルウォッチで血糖値を表示できるよう連携している
relations.text_en: Glucose data can be displayed on Apple Watch devices used with a compatible iPhone

source.label: デクスコム 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: A patient’s glucose data can also be displayed on a patient’s or follower’s wearable device, such as the Apple Watch and Wear OS by Google devices, when used in conjunction with the patient’s or follower’s compatible iPhone or Android mobile device.

relations.text: ガーミンなどのデジタルヘルスアプリとも連携する設計である
relations.text_en: Designed to integrate with the connected CGM ecosystem including Garmin

source.label: デクスコム 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: • Designed to integrate with the world’s largest connected CGM ecosystem (including insulin pumps and smart insulin pens, Apple Watch, Garmin and other digital health apps).
